summary: Full-stack testing of VirtueNova (fashion + room try-on MVP). Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passed covering auth (JWT register/login/me), catalog (products/categories/recommendations/assess with search/filter/sort), visualization (validate + generate for tryon/room, force_fail path, disallowed products), cart CRUD (add/increment/patch qty/delete), wishlist CRUD, and auth protection. Frontend: full E2E flow via Playwright succeeded — login redirect protection, discover grid (10 items, search/filter/sort), product details (color/size/add-to-cart/wishlist/assess sheet), try-on with upload + demo-fail toggle (validation panel with Retake/Upload buttons), room visualization, compare table, cart quantity update reflected in total, wishlist, and post-logout redirect. All data-testid selectors work.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — minor a11y improvement; add SheetDescription or aria-describedby to Sheet/DialogContent components.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription/SheetDescription to Radix Sheet in ProductDetails Assess panel to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS is set to allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False, but backend also sets httpOnly access_token cookies (samesite=none, secure=true). Cookie-based auth will not work cross-origin because credentials aren't allowed and frontend never sends withCredentials. In practice, the frontend uses Bearer token in localStorage, so this is functional but the cookie path is dead code / misleading. Consider either enabling explicit origins + allow_credentials=True, or removing the cookie-setting code.
JWT_SECRET is committed to /app/backend/.env — acceptable for demo/preview but must be rotated/managed via secret store in production.
server.py is a single 547-line file. If features grow, split into routers (auth, catalog, visualize, cart, wishlist).
PATCH /api/cart/{item_id} takes qty as query param — a JSON body would be more idiomatic REST, but current form works and frontend uses it.
Visualize endpoints never actually process the uploaded image (by design per problem statement) — this is documented; no bug.
test_credentials: admin@virtuenova.com / admin123 (seeded); registration creates new users on demand.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create ephemeral users via /api/auth/register with random emails ending @example.com; carts/wishlists are per-user and don't affect the admin account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, xdist-safe, 25 tests, ~5s runtime). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env. Admin creds admin@virtuenova.com/admin123. Products p1-p10 are seeded on backend startup. p1-p4 are tryon-enabled, p7-p10 are room-enabled, p5-p6 are neither. Frontend flows use data-testid selectors (kebab-case) documented in the review request; file input on try-on/room accepts a data URL client-side (backend never receives the image). Radix DialogContent a11y warning is the only outstanding minor item.
